handlers: render chrome: label row, gutter cell, body fill, help/error row (shared by input.rs and textarea.rs)
focus-loss commit: render with !focused && editing calls commit()
flags: disabled (also means read-only: no separate flag exists)
thresholds: optional suffix only when name_w + 12 <= width; TextInput::HEIGHT = 3; TextArea height = rows + 2
TextInput inner width = w - (3 + trailing) with trailing = 2 on error; TextArea inner width = w - 4
timers: none: field chrome is static (no tick-driven frames)
early_returns: empty area returns with zeroed rects; TextInput body needs height >= 2; TextArea body needs rows >= 1
notes: gutter_symbol is ▎ iff focused && !disabled else blank; error marker is bold ! at right-2; help row yields to the error row

handlers: on_key: Enter/F2 begin from navigation; edit_key map while editing; disabled returns Ignored
on_paste: auto-begins from navigation, inserts, live-validates; disabled returns Ignored
on_click: one click begins editing at pointer column + scroll; disabled returns Consumed
thresholds: scroll follows cursor and clamps to total+1-w (insertion cell); … markers at column 0 (scroll>0) and inner.right()-1 (clipped_right)
scroll resets to 0 when !editing; scroll quantizes to a grapheme boundary at or before the cursor
timers: none: single-line fields have no animation clock
early_returns: disabled short-circuits on_key/on_paste/begin_edit; !editing short-circuits on_key to Enter/F2/Ignored; empty area skips render
notes: snapshot discipline: begin_edit captures, cancel restores whole buffer, commit/cancel validate; Tab emits CommittedTab for page focus moves; no undo stack exists (TI-NOOP-004); Shift+Ctrl+Home ignores Shift

handlers: on_key: navigation scroll arms (Up/Down/k/j/paging/jumps) vs editing edit_key map; Esc commits
on_paste: requires editing (Ignored otherwise); on_click: begins editing at line/col; on_wheel: scroll_by with Consumed at bounds
flags: error: Option<String> (owner-set via .error(), no validate() exists)
thresholds: rows clamps to area height - 2; footer splits msg_w vs position label; hscroll follows cursor col within inner width
ensure_visible runs when follow_cursor || cursor moved || resized; !editing resets hscroll to 0
timers: none: text areas have no animation clock
early_returns: disabled short-circuits on_key/on_paste/begin_edit; empty area and rows==0 skip render; !editing short-circuits editing arms
notes: Esc commits (a document is not cancelled); Cancelled is never emitted; plain Enter inserts \n; cursor line gets a border_strong underline; footer shows ln x/y while editing else the overflow label
